notes.title: "LingTian 2" Demo Released
notes.content:
Dear Princess, Your prince "LingTian 2" demo has now been released and is also available to try within the 1000 Princes game. There are slight differences between the two: The standalone "LingTian 2" demo contains the full content of Chapters 1–3, along with music, chat, diary, interviews, and archives. Meanwhile, the in-game trial version of "LingTian 2" in 1000 Princes includes only selected portions from Chapters 1–3.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322260/483381b9c6ba57bed9556af6b2cbe365e369c702.png"]

"LingTian 2" is a sweet and romantic visual novel otome game for women. As an ordinary girl from the Kingdom of Fang, your connection with Prince LingTian begins with your kind heart. Now, your love story is about to begin — embrace this magnificent royal romance! 



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322260/0fdc0595479bf7edb9a3450cb2dd93dd0c762e3c.png"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322260/5b079f2b5f371c867bd8a7fc3a375f0cff43097c.png"]

▌Romance

The royal family of the Kingdom of Fang holds a “Love Seeking Campaign” to help Prince LingTian find his future bride, aiming to divert public attention and ease social tensions. After the royal examination, you and several other girls advance to the final round. However, the moment you step into the palace, the Prince shows you special care and attentively protects you.

Inside the palace, girls must search for hidden “Fang Cards” to earn opportunities for dates with the Prince. Yet, Prince LingTian secretly helps you cheat, offering clues only to you, allowing you to monopolize his time.

Even when you mistakenly bite the Prince, he wholeheartedly defends you without any blame. When you're restrained by soldiers, the Prince ignores his own injuries and scolds them harshly, forbidding them from hurting you.

On a snowy day, the Prince personally welcomes the girls into the palace and gifts them phones as a welcome gift. Soon after, the other girls realize their phones can't contact the Prince at all — only you can call and message him. When you ask him why, he answers tenderly: "Because I only like you. I have no interest in the others. I only care about you, only focus on you, and only want to be with you."

About the 1000 Princes Series 

The "1000 Princes" series is currently undergoing a complete revamp. Moving forward, the focus will be on learning Chinese, including:  
1. Chinese learning tutorial videos with the 1000 Princes  
2. Shorts: Learn Chinese characters with the 1000 Princes  
3. Chinese learning e-book series with the 1000 Princes  
4. Learn Chinese while playing the 1000 Princes Chinese otome games  
5. Learn Chinese through songs by the 1000 Princes

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322260/669ac5b94f07eb0f6e5ec9786d2a86bc0b9d8d61.jpg"]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45322260/ef74fc8838e1af24224b2269dfe18a6d6e4cc6a6.jpg"]

Chinese is the most profound and mysterious language in the world. Each character contains a unique mystical energy, and is associated with one of the five elements: metal, wood, water, fire, and earth. You can observe how different characters align with people, places, time, and events. Each character even holds divinatory power to predict fortune or misfortune. Chinese characters are rare, powerful, and imbued with universal energy and hidden messages. Start learning Chinese with the 1000 Princes today!
